tools.name: get_prevalence
tools.description: Published dyscalculia prevalence figures with sample size, publication year, age, the reference key (see get_reference) and a calc flag (true when the site calculated the figure itself). Filter by study id, by age (entries whose stated age range includes it; entries with no stated age are never matc

tools.name: list_studies
tools.description: Lists every source the statistics page cites (peer-reviewed studies with DOI or PMID, plus official statistics and guidelines), with the topics each supports and, for population studies, the prevalence entries built from them. Filter by topic: prevalence, persistence, math-anxiety, interventions, by

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Full citation for one reference key (for example shalev2000, grosstsur1996), with its DOI and PMID when the site has them, the link the site uses, and the topics that cite it. The site holds 93 references; keys are returned by get_prevalence and list_studies.

tools.name: explain_screening_test
tools.description: Describes the five screening games on dyscalculia.io: what each measures, how many items it has, what an item is and how items and games are scored in general terms, and the limits. tools.name: list_chart_data
tools.description: Lists the chart and table datasets on the statistics page (id, title, topic, section, row count) with their download addresses: the CSV and JSON of the whole page, one SVG per chart, the screening-test JSON and the changelog JSON. Pass an id (for example chart-1, table-2) to get that dataset's rows

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: License (the compilation is CC BY 4.0; each figure belongs to its cited source), the citation text, an HTML credit link and the download addresses. To cite a single number, cite its study: use get_reference.
